guitar.notes: Dimebag Darrell's Dean ML "Dean from Hell" and later Washburn Dime signature are iconic and well documented; entry accurate.

tone.target: tight detuned Pantera groove metal chug with scooped Mesa crunch
tone.profile: tight detuned Pantera groove metal chug with scooped Mesa crunch
tone.summary: A highly aggressive and tight signal chain utilizing a boost for attack, heavy distortion (RAT-style) for saturation, followed by the Recti amp model into a 4x12 cab, optimized with EQ for scooped mids and controlled by a noise gate.
corrections: make gain more saturated than mid-gain
favor Mesa-style metal over generic hard rock

rig.name: Pantera - Cowboys From Hell - Valeton GP-180

blocks.gap: No dedicated compressor/boost is used, but Boost serves the function of increasing transient response.
